method: Three SELECT-only catalog queries; no application rows or credentials retrieved, no DDL/DML or workflow dispatch.
queries: select t.tgname, t.tgrelid::regclass::text as table_name, t.tgdeferrable, t.tginitdeferred, p.proname, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as function_definition from pg_trigger t join pg_proc p on p.oid=t.tgfoid where not t.tgisinternal and (t.tgname ilike '%provenance%' or p.proname ilike '%provenance%') order by table_name,t.tgname

select table_name,column_name,data_type,is_nullable,column_default from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name in ('proposition_voice_chain','evidence_units','evidence_links','transmission_routes') order by table_name,ordinal_position

select table_name,column_name,data_type,is_nullable,column_default from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and (table_name ilike '%evidence%link%' or table_name ilike '%transmission%') order by table_name,ordinal_position

Evidence and voice bigint IDs show no column_default; identity metadata and insert workflow allocation must be checked before concluding IDs require manual assignment.
